summary: Sabesp furnished a 6-K reporting that its Board of Directors approved crediting interest on equity (Brazil's tax-advantaged shareholder remuneration, the local analogue of a dividend declaration) totaling R$2,636,971,532.99 gross, equal to 50% of nine-month 2026 net profit after a 5% legal reserve. That equals R$0.75197707687 per common share, excluding treasury stock. Record date is November 10, 2026, with shares trading ex-interest on B3 from November 11, 2026; payment occurs by the 2026 ordinary general meeting. The credit offsets mandatory 2026 dividends and is not monetarily adjusted. Watch withholding and the ex-date price adjustment.
